title: Device offline alert for building operators

problem.summary: Building operators detect controller connectivity loss too late for timely response.

outcome.statement: Reduce p95 device-offline detection time to no more than 120 seconds.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Create an offline alert within 90 seconds after the allowed heartbeat window.
Close the alert after reconnection and retain offline and online timestamps.

nfrs.statement: False-positive rate remains below 2 percent during the 14-day pilot.
Average controller load increase remains at or below 3 percent.

measurement.metric: p95 offline detection time in seconds
measurement.baseline: 840 seconds over the synthetic 30-day support dataset
measurement.source: demo heartbeat and alert event store
measurement.decision_rule: keep if p95 is at most 120 seconds and false positives are below 2 percent
